title: TAI runtime role grant reconciliation
objective: Repair the exact production blocker TAI_DEPLOY_RUNTIME_ROLE_BOUNDARY_FAILED by reconciling only the bounded tai_* relation and sequence privileges for an already-existing least-privilege tai_runtime role after forward-only migrations create new TAI relations.
boundaries: The migration is a no-op when tai_runtime does not exist
Existing role attributes, memberships and non-TAI relation privileges must already satisfy the fail-closed boundary
Only CONNECT, public schema USAGE and exact privileges on public tai_* relations and sequences are reconciled
No GRANT ALL, ON ALL TABLES, role membership, role attribute or non-TAI privilege expansion is permitted
No production mutation occurs before merge and exact-main release authority
REG.RU only and zero new recurring cost
